sentences.text: Tous les jours, à la même heure, le même homme s'installait au fond du café.
sentences.translation: Every day, at the same hour, the same man would settle at the back of the café.

sentences.text: Il commandait un expresso, ouvrait un carnet et écrivait sans relâche.
sentences.translation: He would order an espresso, open a notebook and write without pause.

sentences.text: Les habitués avaient fini par échafauder mille hypothèses à son sujet.
sentences.translation: The regulars had ended up building a thousand hypotheses about him.

sentences.text: Pour les uns, c'était un romancier en quête d'inspiration ; pour les autres, un espion.
sentences.translation: For some, he was a novelist in search of inspiration; for others, a spy.

sentences.text: Or, nul n'osait l'aborder, de peur de rompre le charme de ce mystère.
sentences.translation: Yet no one dared approach him, for fear of breaking the spell of this mystery.

sentences.text: Un jour d'automne, sa chaise est restée désespérément vide.
sentences.translation: One autumn day, his chair remained hopelessly empty.

sentences.text: Le serveur a alors retrouvé, oublié sous la table, le fameux carnet.
sentences.translation: The waiter then found, forgotten under the table, the famous notebook.

sentences.text: Toutes les pages, sans exception, ne contenaient qu'une seule phrase, recopiée à l'infini.
sentences.translation: Every page, without exception, contained but a single sentence, copied endlessly.

sentences.text: Le serveur a refermé le carnet, soudain conscient d'avoir, lui aussi, trop longtemps attendu.
sentences.translation: The waiter closed the notebook, suddenly aware that he too had waited too long.

glossary.translation: to approach/strike up a conversation with

questions.question: Why did no one approach the stranger?
options: They feared breaking the mystery's spell

questions.question: What did every page of the notebook contain?
What does the waiter realise at the end?
options: He too had waited too long to act

sentences.text: À mesure que les cartons s'empilaient, l'appartement perdait peu à peu son âme.
sentences.translation: As the boxes piled up, the flat gradually lost its soul.

sentences.text: Sur les murs nus subsistaient les traces pâles des cadres décrochés.
sentences.translation: On the bare walls remained the pale marks of the frames taken down.

sentences.text: Hélène errait d'une pièce à l'autre, partagée entre l'impatience et le regret.
sentences.translation: Hélène wandered from room to room, torn between impatience and regret.

sentences.text: Chaque objet emballé ravivait un souvenir qu'elle croyait pourtant oublié.
sentences.translation: Each packed object revived a memory she had nevertheless thought forgotten.

sentences.text: Dans la cuisine, une simple éraflure sur le carrelage lui a serré le cœur.
sentences.translation: In the kitchen, a mere scratch on the tiles tightened her heart.

sentences.text: C'était là que ses enfants, jadis, avaient fait leurs premiers pas.
sentences.translation: It was there that her children had once taken their first steps.

sentences.text: Elle savait bien qu'un logement n'est, au fond, qu'un assemblage de murs.
sentences.translation: She knew full well that a home is, deep down, only an assembly of walls.

sentences.text: Et pourtant, c'était toute une vie qu'elle s'apprêtait à laisser derrière elle.
sentences.translation: And yet, it was a whole life she was about to leave behind.

sentences.text: En fermant la porte, elle a murmuré un adieu que personne n'a entendu.
sentences.translation: Closing the door, she murmured a farewell that no one heard.

questions.question: What remained visible on the bare walls?
options: Pale marks of the removed frames

questions.question: Why did the scratch on the tiles move her?
options: It was where her children took their first steps

questions.question: What is the central tension Hélène feels?
